ps3.5:1.2: iriyāpathacariyā āyatanacariyā saticariyā samādhicariyā ñāṇacariyā maggacariyā patticariyā patticariyā lokatthacariyāti.
ps3.5:2.8: lokatthacariyāti tathāgatesu arahantesu sammāsambuddhesu, padese paccekabuddhesu, padese sāvakesu.
ps3.5:3.8: lokatthacariyā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ, padese paccekabuddhānaṃ, padese sāvakānaṃ.
ps3.5:4.2: adhimuccanto saddhāya carati. paggaṇhanto viriyena carati. upaṭṭhāpentā satiyā carati, avikkhepaṃ karonto samādhinā carati, pajānanto paññāya carati, vijānanto viññāṇacariyāya carati. evaṃ paṭipannassa kusalā dhammā āyāpentīti āyatanacariyāya carati, evaṃ paṭipanno visesamadhigacchatīti visesacariyāya carati.
ps3.5:5.2: dasasnacariyā ca sammādiṭṭhiyā abhiniropanacariyā ca sammāsaṅkappassa, pariggahacariyā ca sammāvācāya, samuṭṭhānacariyā ca sammākammantassa, vodānacariyā ca sammāājīvassa, paggahacariyā ca sammāvāyāmassa, upaṭṭhānacariyā ca sammāsatiyā, avikkhepacariyā ca sammāsamādhissa.
